body:

Type of Punishment (if ban, name how long the ban is):  Poor Behaviour and Failure to Correct Behviour. (Excessive Infractions) (Perm)

I do not deserve to be banned, And whoever banned me learn how to spell Behaviour.

Please respond ASAP because I want to be unbanned

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
We do not need evidence regarding teamspeak punishments and, quite frankly, you were continuously spam poking mods and abusing support room. We do not tolerate this. Considering your previous history regarding in-game punishments and Teamspeak punishments, this ban is justified and will be kept in place.

Regards,
ProfessorUtonium
